overall_summary: Analysis of 47 deduplicated Shorts shows extreme bimodal distribution. First-person experiential cosmic hooks ('What If You Fell Into...') and extreme exoplanetary survival concepts consistently break into top-tier views (700-1,050+ views) with above-average engagement (3-4% like-to-view ratio). Conversely, generic psychology trivia ('Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories', 'Songs Stuck in Your Head') and recycled animal trivia flatline below 50 views and zero likes.

winning_patterns.pattern: First-Person Hazard 'What If You Fell Into...' Framing
winning_patterns.evidence: 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (1,029 views, 38 likes), 'What If You Fell Into the Darkest Planet?' (824 views, 15 likes), and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (972 views, 18 likes) drove the highest velocity and engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Use visceral first-person immersion where the viewer is placed directly into hostile, extreme cosmic environments with step-by-step physical consequences.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos at 19-21 seconds (such as 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' at 981 views and 'TrES-2b' at 1,030 views) outperformed short 12-16s videos by over 300% on total reach and retained engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Target 19-21 seconds with rapid pacing, escalating visual stakes every 4 seconds, and a sharp twist ending.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' (5-53 views, 0 likes across 3 separate uploads), 'Your Brain Is Hiding This From You' (38 views, 0 likes), and 'The Real Reason Songs Get Stuck In Your Head' (17 views, 0 likes).
weak_patterns.action: Cease standard generic psychology and brain trivia until visual storytelling and micro-drama frameworks are integrated.

weak_patterns.pattern: Duplicate Concept Spun Without New Stakes
weak_patterns.evidence: Re-uploading/repeating topics like 'Why Space Is Completely Silent' (34-220 views) and 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' (118-363 views) yielded stagnant or declining view velocities.
weak_patterns.action: Never re-upload identical titles or recycled trivia; every Short must explore a genuinely unaddressed phenomenon.
